description: Create 7 new React frontend pages (MovieSelection, ShowtimeSelection, SeatSelection, Checkout, BookingConfirmation, MyBookings, Bookings) and update App.jsx to wire them into the existing state-based navigation. Independent of FEAT-002 at build time (components just call the API URLs), but must come after FEAT-001/002 for runtime correctness.
steps: Read frontend/src/App.jsx, frontend/src/pages/Movies.jsx, frontend/src/pages/Movies.css, frontend/src/pages/Shows.jsx, frontend/src/pages/Shows.css fully before writing any new files. Match their CSS variable usage and component patterns exactly.

Create frontend/src/pages/MovieSelection.jsx: imports axios, lucide-react (Film, Search, RefreshCw, ChevronRight). API constant 'http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/'. On mount fetch GET /api/movies/ filter to is_active=true. Render page heading 'Book Tickets' with eyebrow 'CUSTOMER BOOKING'. Movie grid using same card structure as Movies.jsx art + card-body. Each card has 'Book Now' button (primary blue). On click: call onNext({selectedMovie: movie}) to transition. Props: {onNext, onBack}. CSS class prefix: 'movie-sel-'.

Create frontend/src/pages/ShowtimeSelection.jsx: props {selectedMovie, onNext, onBack}. On mount fetch GET /api/shows/?movie=<selectedMovie.id> and GET /api/cinemas/. Group shows by cinema, then by show_date. Render cinema cards each with date tabs and time slots. On showtime click: call onNext({selectedShow: show}). Show movie title/poster in heading. CSS class prefix: 'showtime-sel-'.

Create frontend/src/pages/SeatSelection.jsx: props {selectedMovie, selectedShow, onNext, onBack}. On mount fetch GET /api/shows/<selectedShow.id>/availability/. Set up setInterval(fetch, 30000) for polling; clear on unmount. Render: screen div at top ('SCREEN' label, curved bar). Seat grid grouped by row. Each seat is a <button> with class determined by status: 'seat-available' (bg #e5e5ea), 'seat-selected' (bg #007AFF, white text), 'seat-held' (bg #FF9500), 'seat-booked' (bg #636366, disabled). Click toggles selection for available seats. Legend below grid showing Available/Selected/Held/Booked colours. Category legend: Silver/Gold/Premium with price (show.ticket_price * multiplier). Bottom bar: '{N} seats selected', 'Total: ₹{amount}', 'Continue' button (disabled if 0 selected). On Continue: POST /api/shows/<id>/hold/ with {seat_ids:[...selected]}. On success call onNext({heldSeats:seats, sessionToken:session_token, expiresAt:expires_at}). CSS class prefix: 'seat-sel-'.

Create frontend/src/pages/Checkout.jsx: props {selectedMovie, selectedShow, heldSeats, sessionToken, expiresAt, onNext, onBack}. Show booking summary (movie, cinema, date, time, seats, total). Form fields: Full name (required), Email (required, type=email), Phone (required, pattern=[0-9]{10}). Countdown timer showing hold expiry (expiresAt). On submit: POST /api/bookings/create/ with {hold_token:sessionToken, customer_name, customer_email, customer_phone}. On success response: if razorpay_key_id is non-empty, dynamically load Razorpay checkout script (https://checkout.razorpay.com/v1/checkout.js) and open Rzp with options {key:razorpay_key_id, amount:total*100, currency:'INR', order_id:razorpay_order_id, handler: async(response)=>{ await POST /api/payments/verify/ with response; call onNext({bookingRef:booking_reference}); }}. If razorpay_key_id is empty, show 'Test Mode' yellow banner and a 'Simulate Payment Success' button that calls POST /api/payments/verify/ with {razorpay_order_id, razorpay_payment_id:'test_pay_'+Date.now(), razorpay_signature:'test'} then calls onNext. CSS class prefix: 'checkout-'.

Create frontend/src/pages/BookingConfirmation.jsx: props {bookingRef, selectedMovie, selectedShow, onBack}. On mount fetch GET /api/bookings/<bookingRef>/verify/. Render: large green checkmark (Lucide CheckCircle2 icon, color #34C759). 'Booking Confirmed!' heading. Booking reference in monospace box. Movie/cinema/date/time/seats/amount table. 'Download Ticket' button: anchor href to 'http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/bookings/<bookingRef>/ticket/' with download attribute. 'Book Another' button: calls onBack to reset flow. CSS class prefix: 'confirm-'.

Create frontend/src/pages/MyBookings.jsx: standalone page (not part of booking flow). Props: none (rendered by App.jsx on nav click). State: email input, bookings list, loading, error. Form: enter email → submit → GET /api/bookings/my/?email=<email>. Split results into upcoming (show_date >= today) and past. Render two sections each as cards showing movie/cinema/date/seats/status/payment_status. Each card: 'Download Ticket' button (link to ticket endpoint) if status=confirmed; 'Cancel' button if status in [confirmed,pending] calling POST /api/bookings/<id>/cancel/ then refresh. CSS class prefix: 'mybookings-'.

Create frontend/src/pages/Bookings.jsx: admin page. Props: none. On mount: parallel fetch GET /api/admin/bookings/ and GET /api/admin/bookings/stats/. Stats bar at top: Total / Confirmed / Cancelled / Pending / Revenue (matching Shows.jsx stats section style). Filter toolbar: search input, status dropdown, date input, refresh button. Table with columns: Ref, Customer, Movie/Cinema, Date/Time, Seats, Amount, Status, Payment, Actions. Status badge CSS classes: 'booking-status confirmed' (green), 'booking-status cancelled' (red), 'booking-status pending' (orange). Actions column: eye icon (show detail modal), cancel button (if cancellable). Detail modal shows all booking fields. Uses axios with withCredentials:true for admin session auth (DRF SessionAuthentication). CSS class prefix: 'admin-bookings-'.
Update frontend/src/App.jsx:
1. Add imports for all 7 new pages at the top.
2. Add to the navigation array (after Shows entry): {name:'Book Tickets', icon: ShoppingBag} and {name:'My Bookings', icon: Ticket}. Import ShoppingBag from lucide-react.

3. Add booking flow state: const [bookingStep, setBookingStep] = useState(null); const [selectedMovie, setSelectedMovie] = useState(null); const [selectedShow, setSelectedShow] = useState(null); const [heldSeats, setHeldSeats] = useState([]); const [sessionToken, setSessionToken] = useState(''); const [expiresAt, setExpiresAt] = useState(null); const [bookingRef, setBookingRef] = useState('').
4. Define navigateTo to also reset bookingStep to null when navigating away from flow pages.

5. When activePage === 'Book Tickets' and bookingStep === null: render <MovieSelection onNext={data=>{setSelectedMovie(data.selectedMovie);setBookingStep('showtime');}} onBack={()=>navigateTo('Overview')} />.

6. When bookingStep === 'showtime': render <ShowtimeSelection selectedMovie={selectedMovie} onNext={data=>{setSelectedShow(data.selectedShow);setBookingStep('seat');}} onBack={()=>setBookingStep(null)} />.

7. When bookingStep === 'seat': render <SeatSelection selectedMovie={selectedMovie} selectedShow={selectedShow} onNext={data=>{setHeldSeats(data.heldSeats);setSessionToken(data.sessionToken);setExpiresAt(data.expiresAt);setBookingStep('checkout');}} onBack={()=>setBookingStep('showtime')} />.

8. When bookingStep === 'checkout': render <Checkout selectedMovie={selectedMovie} selectedShow={selectedShow} heldSeats={heldSeats} sessionToken={sessionToken} expiresAt={expiresAt} onNext={data=>{setBookingRef(data.bookingRef);setBookingStep('confirmation');}} onBack={()=>setBookingStep('seat')} />.

9. When bookingStep === 'confirmation': render <BookingConfirmation bookingRef={bookingRef} selectedMovie={selectedMovie} selectedShow={selectedShow} onBack={()=>{setBookingStep(null);navigateTo('Book Tickets');}} />.

10. In content-area render block: add conditions for 'Book Tickets' (renders booking flow or MovieSelection), 'My Bookings' (renders <MyBookings />), 'Bookings' (renders <Bookings /> instead of PlaceholderPage). Add 'Book Tickets' and 'My Bookings' to the array in the final catch-all check.
11. Update pageTitles object to include 'Book Tickets', 'My Bookings'.
Create frontend/.env.example with content: VITE_RAZORPAY_KEY_ID=your_razorpay_key_id_here
Run: cd frontend && npm run build. Fix all JSX/import errors until build exits 0.
Set FEAT-003 status to 'completed' and record findings.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build (from frontend/) exits 0 with no errors.
App.jsx imports all 7 new pages without duplicate imports.
Clicking 'Book Tickets' in sidebar renders MovieSelection page.
Clicking 'My Bookings' in sidebar renders MyBookings page.
Clicking 'Bookings' in sidebar renders the new admin Bookings page (not PlaceholderPage).
Existing Overview/Movies/Cinemas/Shows pages still render correctly.
SeatSelection renders seats as individual button elements (not a static image).
Checkout shows test-mode banner when VITE_RAZORPAY_KEY_ID is not set.
findings: All 7 pages created: MovieSelection, ShowtimeSelection, SeatSelection, Checkout, BookingConfirmation, MyBookings, Bookings. App.jsx updated with full booking flow state machine (bookingStep: null→showtime→seat→checkout→confirmation). ShoppingBag and Ticket nav items added. Bookings page replaces PlaceholderPage for the existing Bookings nav entry. Checkout implements dynamic Razorpay script loading with test-mode yellow banner fallback when VITE_RAZORPAY_KEY_ID is not set. SeatSelection uses individual <button> elements per seat with status-based CSS classes. All CSS files use page-specific class prefixes matching the spec. Build verified: npm run build exits 0 (360KB JS bundle, 60KB CSS, 1.53s).
